messages:
ana: quick favor — can someone kick off a small perf sweep for the int4+fp8 combo on r7b-3? saw a latency spike in the canary last night, want throughput + quality deltas vs main

mike: on it. which workloads should I run? short-chat (seq256), long-gen (seq1024), and embeddings?

jordan: prioritize short-chat and long-gen. embeddings later if the other two look good. also please include batch=1,4,8

mike: copying the command I'll run: ```./bench/run_infer.sh --model r7b-3 --quant int4+fp8 --batches 1,4,8 --seq 256,1024 --warmup 10 --iters 100 --out perf.json```

ana: @mike small note: use the same seed and tokenization as main branch to keep quality apples-to-apples (seed=42, tokenizer v3)

mike: ack. using seed=42 and tok v3. will push perf.json to /data/bench/1812345678/ when done

perf-bot: run started: id=run-1812345678-1 (r7b-3 int4+fp8)

kevin: fyi, canary had a ~12ms median increase on seq256 last night, might show up here. if you see that, tag it and I'll look into kernel selection logs

mike: initial short-chat (seq256) results: batch=1  median_lat=78ms  p95=120ms  tps=12.3; batch=4  median=95ms  p95=160ms  tps=42.8; compared to main: batch1 median was 66ms, batch4 median 88ms. saving diffs now

jordan: thanks. what's the quality delta? any perplexity or token-level regressions?

mike: quality quick-check against eval-set-small: ppl_main=12.1 ppl_combo=12.6 (+4.1%), rouge-l delta ~ -0.9% (small dataset)

ana: +4% ppl is noticeable. Could be due to FP8 scaling on attention kernels. Can you snapshot kernel logs and the quant config used?

mike: yes — attaching config snippet: ```quant: { scheme: 'mixed', fp8_mode: 'e4m3', scale_clip: 0.02, kv_cache_dtype: 'fp16' }```

perf-bot: run completed: id=run-1812345678-1  elapsed=38m  artifacts=/data/bench/1812345678/perf.json  metrics=/data/bench/1812345678/metrics.json

kevin: copying metrics now. if the ppl hit is due to scaling, we can try lowering scale_clip to 0.015 or fall back to int8 for attention weights only. can we do a quick ablation?

jordan: suggestion: try two quick follow-ups: (A) reduce scale_clip to 0.015 (B) same config but attention quant -> int8. run only seq256 batch=1 for both — 20 iterations. should be fast

mike: will run A and B now. expect ~10-12min each. launching A first

ana: also ping ML-evals team to run a few of the saved prompts (edge cases) if A looks promising

mike: A done: ppl=12.3 (+1.6% vs main), median_lat=80ms. B done: ppl=12.05 (+0.4% vs main), median_lat=70ms. artifacts in /data/bench/1812345678/ablation_A.json and ablation_B.json

jordan: ok that's useful. B (attention=int8) gives near-main quality and latency improvement — sounds like a decent fallback policy for canary.

kevin: agree. proposal: for the rollout we can default to mixed int4+fp8, but automatically fallback attention->int8 if ppl delta > 2% on eval suite or if median_lat > target + 15ms. I'll draft the config change and a rollout canary test

ana: please add the eval prompts for edge cases before large rollout. also create a ticket to track kernel scaling investigation (assign to me)

jordan: created ticket RN-4572 with notes + links to artifacts

mike: closing the loop — I pushed perf artifacts and a short README in that dir. will follow up with a small PR that adds the automatic fallback rule to serving config

ana: thanks everyone. nice quick turnaround :thumbsup:

perf-bot: reaction: :white_check_mark:
